s: December 12, 2025 - Officially recognized by the shogunate in 1730, the DRE was a place where traders could buy and sell notes promising the delivery of an amount of rice at a future date. Changes in supply could radically alter the price of rice, so a lot of speculation happened at the exchange, not unlike during the Dutch tulipmania. The traders reportedly relied on a complex system of flag signals and couriers to get the information about the most recent prices as fast as possible to gain an advantage in dealmaking.
